condition.earlyExitJustified: an early exit can only cost what is justified or proportionate to the discount received
condition.equivalentGuarantees: the replacement policy must offer equivalent guarantees
condition.equivalentToBank: the replacement policy must be equivalent to what the bank requires
condition.firstYear: free cancellation opens after the first year; before that, the contract ends at its anniversary with the notice of the contract (commonly two months)
condition.fixedTermOffer: this looks like a fixed-term offer: read its conditions for any exit clause
condition.groupContract: an employer-mandated group contract cannot be cancelled this way (only on a qualifying event)
condition.hamonEligible: free cancellation at any time (Hamon) applies to eligible car and home policies: check whether yours is one; otherwise the contract ends at its anniversary with the notice of the contract (commonly two months)
condition.longPolicyIt: a policy longer than five years (with a duration discount) can be ended by the insured after the fifth year with 60 days' notice, effective at the end of the policy year (art. 1899 c.c.); annual policies follow the contract
condition.minimumTerm: the minimum term runs until this date: leaving earlier is governed by the contract
condition.noGapInCover: the old policy ends the day the new one starts: there must be no gap in cover
condition.rcAutoExpiry: no notice is needed: the policy simply ends at expiry (the cover lasts 15 more days); mid-term only for sale, destruction or theft of the vehicle
condition.renewedWithoutReminder: it renewed on {{renewal_date}}: if the provider did not remind you before that date, you may be able to terminate at any time (see the rules)
condition.rollingMonthly: a rolling monthly subscription normally ends at the end of the period already paid
condition.singlePremiumRefund: a single premium: ask for the refund of the unused part on early closure
condition.telecomCommitment: leaving before the end of the commitment costs the early termination amount; waiting until {{free_date}} is free

method.energyFr: subscribe to the new supplier, who cancels the old contract for you; do not cancel first (no gap in supply)
method.energyIt: sign with the new supplier, who sends the recesso; a direct request goes to the current supplier

method.genericIt: the method in the contract (online area, letter or certified e-mail)
method.insuranceFr: written request (registered letter, e-mail or the insurer's online form), or let the new insurer send it for you; a contract signed online can be terminated online (3 clicks)
method.insuranceIt: disdetta by registered letter or certified e-mail within the period in the policy
method.insuranceOtherFr: written request (registered letter, e-mail or the insurer's online form) before the notice deadline

method.loanInsuranceIt: present the new policy to the bank

method.telecomIt: written request to the operator (e-mail or registered letter) or through the new operator

noticeAssumption.twoMonths: two months unless the contract says otherwise (L113-12)

frHamon.name: Loi Hamon (insurance after the first year)
frHamon.summary: Home and car insurance can be cancelled at any time after the first year, free of charge; the cancellation takes effect one month after the insurer receives the request (the new insurer can send it for you).

frChatelInsurance.name: Tacit renewal of insurance (Loi Chatel)
frChatelInsurance.summary: The contract ends at its anniversary with the notice of the contract (L113-12; commonly two months). The insurer must send the renewal notice (avis d'echeance) in time: if it is sent less than 15 days before the deadline for refusing the renewal, or after it, the insured has 20 days from its sending to cancel (L113-15-1).

frRiaSante.name: Complementary health (mutuelle): resiliation infra-annuelle
frRiaSante.summary: A complementary health contract can be cancelled at any time after one year, free of charge, effective one month after the request. Employer-mandated group contracts are not covered.

frLemoine.name: Borrower insurance: Loi Lemoine
frLemoine.summary: The insurance of a loan can be replaced at any time, free of charge, by a policy with equivalent guarantees; the lender must answer within 10 working days.

frTelecom.name: Telecom contracts (Loi Chatel)
frTelecom.summary: A commitment is limited to 24 months. After the first 12 months an early exit costs at most 25 % of the subscription still due; without a commitment, or after it, the contract can be ended at any time, normally within about ten days of the request.

frEnergy.name: Electricity and gas for households
frEnergy.summary: No termination fee for household electricity or gas; the new supplier handles the switch (typically within three weeks). Fixed-term market offers may state conditions: read them.

fr3Clics.name: Termination online ("resiliation en 3 clics")
fr3Clics.summary: A contract that can be signed online must be terminable online through a clearly visible button; the provider must confirm the date the contract ends.

frChatelRenewal.name: Tacit renewal of service contracts (Loi Chatel)
frChatelRenewal.summary: For a tacitly renewed contract the provider must remind you, between three and one month before the end of the period in which you can refuse the renewal. If it did not, you can terminate at any time after the renewal and get the unused part refunded.

itBersaniTelecom.name: Telecom and pay-TV: Legge Bersani
itBersaniTelecom.summary: The customer can withdraw at any time without penalties; only costs justified by the real cost of closing, or proportionate to a discount received, can be charged. Notice is at most 30 days.

itBersaniEnergy.name: Electricity and gas: recesso (ARERA)
itBersaniEnergy.summary: A household can withdraw at any time without penalties; notice is at most one month, and a switch to a new supplier is handled by the new supplier.

itRcauto.name: RC auto: no tacit renewal
itRcauto.summary: The motor third-party policy ends at its expiry: there is no tacit renewal, so no cancellation notice is needed; shop for a new policy before the expiry. The cover continues for 15 days after the expiry (grace period).

itInsurance.name: Other insurance: disdetta
itInsurance.summary: Annual non-life policies renew tacitly unless a notice (disdetta) is sent within the period in the policy. A policy longer than five years (with a discount for its duration) can be cancelled by the insured after the fifth year with 60 days' notice, effective at the end of the policy year (art. 1899 c.c.).

itLoanInsurance.name: Insurance linked to a mortgage
itLoanInsurance.summary: The borrower may bring a policy of their choice (the bank must accept an equivalent one); the unused part of a single premium is refundable on early closure of the loan.

itSubscription.name: Subscriptions: Codice del consumo
itSubscription.summary: Terms of renewal and withdrawal are those of the contract; the 14-day withdrawal right applies only to distance contracts at signing.

unknown.startLowerBound: contract start date (only the first payment seen is known, and it is less than a year old)

infer.insuranceRateSubtracted: the insurance premium computed from its rate is assumed to be debited WITH the instalment and is subtracted
infer.mayIncludeInsurance: the instalment may include the borrower insurance (not recorded): the capital and the rate inferred would then be a little too high
infer.variableRate: variable / mixed rate: the inferred rate is the one that fits the current instalment
infer.notLargerThanInsurance: the instalment is not larger than the insurance
infer.noRateFits: no rate fits: the instalments over the term total less than the capital (a wrong capital or term?)
infer.noTermFits: the instalment does not cover the interest on the capital: a wrong capital, rate or instalment
infer.allRecorded: principal, rate and term are all recorded: nothing to infer (the schedule check compares them with the payments)
infer.principalNotDerivable: principal is not derivable from the remaining capital alone: record it from the loan offer

checklist.buy: if you buy the car: the option price is the residual value; ask the lender for the payoff letter and the deadline to exercise it

extra.bodyOffDayOtherSize: A debit of {{payment_amount}} on {{payment_date}} matches this loan but is away from the usual payment day and of another size. It may be a partial early repayment: if so, ask the lender for the new schedule and update the capital still due.

wrongAccount.title: {{lender}}: paid from another account
wrongAccount.body: The payment of {{payment_date}} ({{payment_amount}}) left {{account}}, not {{expected_account}}, the account the loan is recorded to be debited from.

capital.title: {{lender}}: the schedule differs from the declared capital
capital.body: Your statement of {{statement_date}} says {{declared_amount}} is due; the theoretical table says {{computed_amount}} on that date. The declared figure is used (rolled forward). Was there an early repayment or a renegotiation? Update the loan (rate, term, capital).

loaEnd.title_one: {{lender}} ends in {{count}} day: buy or return?
loaEnd.title_other: {{lender}} ends in {{count}} days: buy or return?
loaEnd.body: The contract ends on {{end_date}}. Decide between buying the car (option price {{option_amount}}) and returning it; the return checklist and the mileage projection are on the loan page. Verify the notice period in your contract.
loaEnd.bodyNoOptionPrice: The contract ends on {{end_date}}. Decide between buying the car (option price unknown: record residual_value) and returning it; the return checklist and the mileage projection are on the loan page. Verify the notice period in your contract.

loaMileage.title: {{lender}}: about {{excess_km, number}} km over the limit at the end
loaMileage.body: At the current pace the projected mileage is {{projected_km, number}} km against a limit of {{limit_km, number}} km, an estimated {{fee_amount}} of excess-mileage fees.
loaMileage.bodyNoFee: At the current pace the projected mileage is {{projected_km, number}} km against a limit of {{limit_km, number}} km. Record the excess fee to price it.

loaMileageMissing.title: {{lender}}: record the current mileage
loaMileageMissing.body: Within 6 months of the end of the contract the mileage matters: record the odometer (date and km) so the coach can project the excess-mileage cost.

netWorth.lease: lease: no capital owed, not counted
netWorth.leaseRents: lease: no capital owed, not counted; the remaining rents are a commitment shown as the amount
netWorth.fromScheduleApprox: computed from the amortization schedule (variable rate: approximate)
netWorth.declaredRolled: the declared capital of {{declared_date}} rolled forward with the loan's rate and instalments
netWorth.declaredAsIs: the declared capital of {{declared_date}} (it cannot be rolled forward)
netWorth.fromScheduleDiffers: computed from the amortization schedule; it differs from the theoretical table ({{theoretical_amount}} today): early repayment or renegotiation? update the loan
netWorth.fromScheduleApproxDiffers: computed from the amortization schedule (variable rate: approximate); it differs from the theoretical table ({{theoretical_amount}} today): early repayment or renegotiation? update the loan
netWorth.declaredRolledDiffers: the declared capital of {{declared_date}} rolled forward with the loan's rate and instalments; it differs from the theoretical table ({{theoretical_amount}} today): early repayment or renegotiation? update the loan
netWorth.declaredAsIsDiffers: the declared capital of {{declared_date}} (it cannot be rolled forward); it differs from the theoretical table ({{theoretical_amount}} today): early repayment or renegotiation? update the loan
netWorth.knownOnly: only what is known is added up: an unknown item is listed and NOT counted, so the real figure differs
netWorth.balanceNotKnownOnDate: balance not known on that date
netWorth.valueKnownFromUnknownDate: value only known from an unknown date
netWorth.capitalNotKnownOnDate: capital not known on that date
netWorth.nonBookedCaveat_one: {{count}} account balance is an available / expected balance (ITAV, XPCD...), not a booked one: pending items can make this month differ slightly from the bank's own figure
netWorth.nonBookedCaveat_other: {{count}} account balances are available / expected balances (ITAV, XPCD...), not booked ones: pending items can make this month differ slightly from the bank's own figure
netWorth.liabilitiesNote: Remaining capital comes from the amortization schedule when it is computable, else the declared figure.
netWorth.syncedAsset: synced from a bank: counted through its balance
netWorth.total: The total counts only what is known. Liabilities come from the amortization schedule when it is computable, else the declared capital.
netWorth.totalPartial_one: The total counts only what is known; {{count}} item has no value and is NOT included, so the real figure differs. Liabilities come from the amortization schedule when it is computable, else the declared capital.
netWorth.totalPartial_other: The total counts only what is known; {{count}} items have no value and are NOT included, so the real figure differs. Liabilities come from the amortization schedule when it is computable, else the declared capital.
netWorth.historyNote: 'snapshot' = recorded on that day; 'backfill' = rebuilt from bank balances and transactions (bank accounts only), amortization schedules and manual assets from their own as_of date. A month with unknown items is the known part only.

unused.body_one: You recorded {{last_used_date}} as the last time you used it ({{count}} day ago). This comes from your own record, not from the bank data. Worth reviewing whether to keep it.
unused.body_other: You recorded {{last_used_date}} as the last time you used it ({{count}} days ago). This comes from your own record, not from the bank data. Worth reviewing whether to keep it.

neverUsed.title: {{service}}: marked 'never used' but still paid
neverUsed.body: You recorded that you never use it, and the last payment was {{last_date}}. Worth reviewing whether to keep it.

notice.title_one: {{service}}: last day to give notice in {{count}} day
notice.title_other: {{service}}: last day to give notice in {{count}} days
notice.bodyRenews: {{notice_date}} is the last day to give notice before it renews ({{reference_date}}). Verify with your contract; nothing is cancelled by the coach.
notice.bodyCommitmentEnds: {{notice_date}} is the last day to give notice before the commitment ends ({{reference_date}}). Verify with your contract; nothing is cancelled by the coach.
notice.bodyAnniversary: {{notice_date}} is the last day to give notice before it renews on {{reference_date}}. Verify with your contract; nothing is cancelled by the coach.

stillCharged.renegotiated: {{service}}: still charged the old price after you renegotiated
stillCharged.downgraded: {{service}}: still charged the old price after you downgraded
stillCharged.kept: {{service}}: the charge differs from what you decided to keep

basis.capPerM2: the cap per m² you declared × the surface you declared
basis.rentObserved: the last rent received (it may be net of management fees: the cap applies to the lease rent)

equity.beforeCosts: Before the selling costs, the early-repayment penalty and any tax on a capital gain: none of them is modelled.
equity.missingCapital: the capital still due of a loan (its terms or a declared outstanding)
equity.missingLoan: the loan (link it with `loan`), or record that there is none
equity.missingValue: the value (the valuation you believe, with as_of)
equity.valueOld: The valuation dates from {{value_date}}: update it.
equity.valueUndated: The valuation has no as_of date.

links.accountNotInData: The account named on the property is not in the data (excluded, to review, or a wrong uid / label).
links.loanNotOnFile: The loan named on the property is not in the loan files.

market.future: The date of the market rate is in the future.
market.missing: Enter the current market rate for a loan of similar duration (your own quote or a comparator you looked at, with its date): the coach never looks it up.
market.old_one: The market rate is {{count}} day old (more than {{max_days}}): do not present it as current.
market.old_other: The market rate is {{count}} days old (more than {{max_days}}): do not present it as current.
market.undated: The date of the market rate was not given: treat it as possibly outdated.

need.account: the property's bank account (its flows, the P&L)
need.commitmentStart: the end date of the commitment and its reminders
need.commitmentYears: the end date of the commitment (6, 9 or 12 years for a Pinel-type scheme)
need.loan: the loan that financed it (interest, outstanding capital, equity)
need.purchase: the figures of the tax return and the scheme reduction
need.reductionRate: the scheme reduction candidate of the tax return
need.rentMonthly: the expected rent (vacancy and rent cap checks)
need.value: the valuation for the net equity (the latest value you believe, with as_of)

rate.above: The loan rate is {{gap}} point(s) above the market rate you entered: a quote may be worth asking for.
rate.below: The loan rate is below the market rate you entered: a renegotiation would raise it.
rate.close: The loan rate is close to the market rate you entered: little to gain from a renegotiation on the rate alone.
rate.missingLoan: the loan and its nominal rate
rate.missingNominal: the nominal rate of the loan (rate.nominal)
rate.noFees: No fee was given: add the bank fees, the guarantee fees and the penalty of your contract to price it (`coach rental indicators --bank-fees ...`).

reduction.assumption: Assumption: the total rate is spread evenly over the commitment years; declare `commitment.reduction_schedule` (segments of years at a yearly rate) if the scheme spreads it differently.
reduction.cappedDeclared: The price is capped by the ceiling you declared ({{cap_amount}}).
reduction.cappedM2: The price is capped by {{m2_cap_amount}}/m² × {{surface}} m² ({{cap_amount}}).
reduction.cappedPinel: The price is capped by the Pinel ceiling of {{cap_amount}}.
reduction.declaredSchedule: The yearly schedule is the one you declared (commitment.reduction_schedule).
reduction.missingRate: {{field}} (the total reduction over the commitment, from the scheme's table)
reduction.notADeduction: The reduction lowers the tax: it is not a deduction from the rental income, and it does not depend on the micro-foncier / régime réel choice.
reduction.nothingLookedUp: The rate, the price and the ceilings are the ones recorded on the property (declared by you, or the dated Pinel table): nothing is looked up.
reduction.ratesClassic: Pinel rates of a purchase up to 2022.
reduction.shapeKept: Your declared total rate differs from the Pinel table: its 9 + 3 year shape is kept in the table's proportion.
reduction.spreadEvenly: Your declared total rate differs from the Pinel table: it is spread evenly over the commitment.
reduction.verify: The Pinel split (rates by purchase year, 9 + 3 years for a 12-year commitment, ceilings of {{price_cap_amount}} and {{m2_cap_amount}}/m²) is the one known in {{reviewed_month}}: verify it on impots.gouv.fr.

scenario.prepay: `coach loans scenario prepay <loan> --amount N` or the `what_if` tool (`prepay_loan`): a prepayment on the exact schedule.
scenario.renegotiate: `coach loans scenario renegotiate <loan> --new-rate R` (or the `mortgage_check` tool with `market_rate_pct`): the renegotiation priced on the real schedule.

scheme.pinelYears: A Pinel-type commitment usually lasts 6, 9 or 12 years: {{years}} was recorded, check the deed.

signal.commitmentEnding_one: The commitment ends in about {{count}} month ({{end_date}}): extend it (if the scheme allows it), keep renting under the ordinary rules, or sell. Check the consequences of each with the scheme's rules or an adviser.
signal.commitmentEnding_other: The commitment ends in about {{count}} months ({{end_date}}): extend it (if the scheme allows it), keep renting under the ordinary rules, or sell. Check the consequences of each with the scheme's rules or an adviser.
signal.commitmentOver: The commitment ended on {{end_date}}: the scheme's constraints (rent cap, tenant limits) may no longer apply; verify what changes for the property.
signal.commitmentRunning: The commitment is running: ending it early (selling, stopping the rental) can call the scheme's advantage into question. Verify with the scheme's rules before any decision.
signal.equityNegative: The declared valuation is below the capital still due: selling would not repay the loan.
signal.equityPositive: The declared valuation is above the capital still due.

bound.borrowerInsurance: Theoretical table: the lender's statement decides.
bound.charges: Upper bound: only the non-recoverable part counts (the syndic's statement splits it).
bound.flatAllowance: A candidate line: a flat {{flat_amount}} per property in the régime réel; verify that it applies to you.
bound.interest: Theoretical table: report the lender's annual statement.
bound.interestPartial: Theoretical table: report the lender's annual statement (partial year: the table starts mid-year).
bound.propertyTax: Upper bound: the household-waste part reimbursed by the tenant is not deductible.
bound.works: Upper bound: building or enlargement works are not deductible; check each invoice.

tax.deficit: A candidate déficit foncier computed with the rules known in {{reviewed_month}} ({{ceiling_amount}} a year on the global income; the part due to the loan interest and the excess are carried forward on the rental income of the next ten years): verify the conditions (a ceiling and a holding period apply) with the tax office or an adviser.
tax.incomeYear: {{year}} is the income year: declared in the spring of {{filing_year}}.

notDeductible.ownTransfers: the owner's own transfers into the account

tax.notModelled: Only the French rental-income return is modelled (micro-foncier / régime réel); the Italian one is not.

note.flows: Candidates computed from the bank flows of the property account: a payment in the wrong category moves them.
note.netRent: If the manager pays the rent net of its fees, the gross rent is higher than the rent received: the manager's annual statement gives it.
note.overCeiling: The household's gross rents are above the micro-foncier ceiling: that regime would not apply.
note.rules: The ceiling and the abatement are those known in {{reviewed_month}}: verify them, and the consequences of choosing the régime réel (it binds you for several years), with the tax office or an adviser.
note.yearInProgress: {{year}} is not over: only its closed months are counted.

source.schedule: amortization schedule of the loan file

tax.unknownInterest: loan interest and borrower insurance: the loan is not known or its schedule cannot be computed for this year (link the loan, see `coach rental scheme`); the lender's annual statement gives them

schemeEnd.title_one: {{property}}: the scheme commitment ends on {{end_date}} (about {{count}} month left)
schemeEnd.title_other: {{property}}: the scheme commitment ends on {{end_date}} (about {{count}} months left)
schemeEnd.body: No decision about the extension is recorded. Decide whether to extend (if the scheme allows it), keep renting under the ordinary rules or sell, check the consequences in the scheme's rules or with an adviser, then record the decision (`coach rental extension`).

rentMissing.title: {{property}}: no rent seen for {{rent_month}}
rentMissing.body: The account data cover {{rent_month}} and hold no rent. If the property was empty, record the period in `vacancies` (it is then not reported again); otherwise check with the tenant or the property manager.
rentMissing.bodyExpected: The account data cover {{rent_month}} and hold no rent (about {{expected_amount}} expected). If the property was empty, record the period in `vacancies` (it is then not reported again); otherwise check with the tenant or the property manager.

rentLate.title: {{property}}: this month's rent has not arrived
rentLate.body_one: No rent has been seen in {{rent_month}} and the usual day (plus {{count}} day) has passed.
rentLate.body_other: No rent has been seen in {{rent_month}} and the usual day (plus {{count}} days) has passed.

rentCap.title: {{property}}: the rent is above the cap you declared
rentCap.bodyDeclared: Rent {{rent_amount}} against a cap of {{cap_amount}} (the lease rent you declared). Check the scheme's rules and the lease: a rent above the cap can put the advantage at risk.
rentCap.bodyObserved: Rent {{rent_amount}} against a cap of {{cap_amount}} (the last rent received: it may be net of management fees, the cap applies to the lease rent). Check the scheme's rules and the lease: a rent above the cap can put the advantage at risk.

tenantIncome.title: {{property}}: the tenant income is above the limit you declared
tenantIncome.body: Tenant income {{income_amount}} against a limit of {{limit_amount}}. Check the scheme's rules for the tenant household's size.

scenario.needsSchedule: the amortization schedule cannot be computed: record these fields (or accept the questions the coach proposes)
scenario.nothingLeft: no instalment remains after that date
scenario.payoff: the amount covers the whole capital: ask the lender for a payoff quote (capital + accrued interest + penalty)
scenario.deferralNotModelled: a prepayment during a deferral is not modelled: ask the lender
scenario.flatInsurance: a flat insurance premium is not reduced by a partial prepayment unless the lender recalculates it: only the months saved (keep the instalment) change what is paid in insurance
scenario.estimate: estimate from the stored schedule at the current nominal rate; the lender's table decides.

penalty.override: the amount you gave (from your contract)
penalty.ira: IRA (Code de la consommation L313-47): the lower of six months of interest on the amount prepaid ({{six_months_amount}}) and 3 % of the capital due before the prepayment ({{cap_amount}}); your contract may waive it, or apply it only to some cases
penalty.itMortgage: no penalty by law for the early repayment of a mortgage of a natural person for the purchase or renovation of residential property (art. 120-ter TUB, from the Bersani decree): check your contract
penalty.frConsumerFree: FR consumer credit (Code de la consommation L312-34): no indemnity when the amount repaid over 12 months is at most {{free_amount}}; earlier prepayments of the same 12 months add up: give the penalty of your contract if they do
penalty.frConsumerLong: FR consumer credit (L312-34): at most 1 % of the amount repaid (more than a year of the contract is left) = {{penalty_amount}}; your contract may waive it
penalty.frConsumerShort: FR consumer credit (L312-34): at most 0.5 % of the amount repaid (less than a year of the contract is left) = {{penalty_amount}}; your contract may waive it
penalty.other: no legal penalty is modelled for this kind of loan: give the amount of your contract in the penalty field

schedule.paymentDiffersHint: variable rate, modulated instalments, fees or a wrong figure: check the loan table
schedule.tableDiffersHint: the table differs from the declared capital: the rate, the term, a deferral or an early repayment may not be what the memory says
schedule.declaredWinsHint: the declared capital wins over the theoretical table: was there an early repayment or a renegotiation? update the loan
schedule.variableRate: variable / mixed rate: the current nominal rate is applied to the whole term (the bank's table will differ when the index moves)
schedule.leaseAlternative: a lease has rents and a residual value, not an amortization table and no capital owed: see the end-of-contract view
schedule.outstandingAlternative: outstanding + outstanding_as_of + rate.nominal + (end_date or monthly_payment) give the FUTURE table: missing {{fields}}
schedule.declaredRolled: the declared capital differs from the theoretical table: the declared figure is rolled forward from its date
schedule.declaredAsIs: the declared capital differs from the table and cannot be rolled forward: the declared figure is used as it is; the instalments listed are the theoretical ones
schedule.annuity: annuity loan, interest = capital x nominal rate / 12 per instalment
schedule.firstDueDay: first instalment due {{first_date}}, debited on day {{day}}
schedule.deferralPartial_one: interest-only deferral of {{count}} month: the capital does not move; the insurance is still paid
schedule.deferralPartial_other: interest-only deferral of {{count}} months: the capital does not move; the insurance is still paid
schedule.deferralTotal_one: total deferral of {{count}} month: the interest is added to the capital; the insurance is still paid
schedule.deferralTotal_other: total deferral of {{count}} months: the interest is added to the capital; the insurance is still paid
schedule.outstandingStart: the capital still due on {{as_of_date}} is the starting point; earlier instalments are not known
schedule.instalmentDayAssumed: instalments assumed on day {{day}} (payment_day is not recorded)
schedule.termFromPayment: end_date unknown: the term follows from monthly_payment (assumed to exclude insurance when the insurance amount is unknown)
schedule.termFromPaymentFlatInsurance: end_date unknown: the term follows from monthly_payment minus the flat insurance
schedule.totalsUnknown: totals and interest paid to date are unknown (the table starts at the declared capital); remaining interest and the yearly figures of the future are exact

alternatives.note: quotes older than 30 days are outdated and excluded from the best; prices change: verify on the provider's page before acting
alternatives.staleWarning: price older than 30 days: re-check before relying on it

decision.ambiguous_one: the contract covers {{count}} recurring series: record the decision on one series (name it) so the bank data can be checked
decision.ambiguous_other: the contract covers {{count}} recurring series: record the decision on one series (name it) so the bank data can be checked
decision.asRecorded: the payment of {{payment_date}} is {{monthly_amount}} a month, as recorded
decision.kept: nothing to verify: the subscription was kept
decision.nextNotOverdue: no later payment yet, but the next one is not overdue
decision.noPaymentNextOverdue: no payment since {{last_date}}, the next one is overdue
decision.noPaymentSinceEffective: no payment on or after the effective date yet
decision.otherAmount: the payment of {{payment_date}} is {{monthly_amount}} a month, not the {{recorded_amount}} recorded
decision.paymentsAfter_one: {{count}} payment after the effective date {{effective_date}}; latest {{last_date}} ({{last_amount}})
decision.paymentsAfter_other: {{count}} payments after the effective date {{effective_date}}; latest {{last_date}} ({{last_amount}})
decision.seriesNotFound: the recurring series is not in the bank data (not found): confirm it by hand
decision.stillOldAmount: the payment of {{payment_date}} is still about the old amount ({{monthly_amount}} a month)

draft.indistinguishable_one: {{count}} other recurring series cannot be told apart from this one by label and amount ({{series}}): one contract file covers both; give it a more specific merchant_match if they are separate contracts
draft.indistinguishable_other: {{count}} other recurring series cannot be told apart from this one by label and amount ({{series}}): one contract file covers them all; give it a more specific merchant_match if they are separate contracts
draft.matchedBy_one: {{series}} would be matched by {{count}} contract file (expected exactly one)
draft.matchedBy_other: {{series}} would be matched by {{count}} contract files (expected exactly one)
draft.noBillingPeriod: the payment ({{cadence}}) has no matching billing period: billing left empty
draft.noMerchantMatch: no merchant_match regex could be built that links to this series' payments

inventory.cancellationSummary: cancellation info is a general summary of consumer-law rules: verify with your contract
inventory.costSource: the cost comes from the detected payments; a contract file without payments in the bank data uses its billing amount
inventory.notSubscriptions: loans, mortgages, rent and taxes are not subscriptions and are not listed

savings.note: only decisions the bank data confirms count as realised; pending ones are claims (a cancelled service still being paid is flagged). Months are whole calendar months from the effective date.

usage.fromLastUsed: from the last-used date you recorded
usage.neverAndPaying: you recorded 'never' and the payments continue
usage.notMeasurable: Whether a service is used is not in the bank data: only what you record (frequency, last used) is counted. Without it the usage stays unknown.
